reranked_evidence.snippet: 4. Read Mani Shankar Aiyar's poem dedicated to his wife Suneet. Raj Singh Published : Jan 28, 2014, 01:36 PM IST Updated : Mar 08, 2014, 06:56 AM IST. ## New Delhi: Veteran Congress leader Mani Shankar Aiyar may be stubborn on his principles but there is another side to his persona which is soft and understanding. Mani loves to write poems and the one poem that he dedicated to his wife Suneet sums up the excitement of his life when he was 18. Mani loves to write poems and the one poem.
